mapper.sql: c.CLASS_CODE, c.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, ( SELECT MIN(ci.IMAGE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ci.SORT_ORDER) FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND ci.TYPE = '대표' ) AS THUMBNAIL_PATH, ( SELECT ct.NAME FROM CATEGORY ct WHERE ct.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE ) AS CATEGORY_NAME, '개별일정' AS SCHEDULE_TYPE, c.DESIRED_PRICE, c.WRITE_DATE AS REGISTERED_DATE, ( SELECT MIN(r.OPERATION_START_DATE) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUIT_START_DATE, ( SELECT MAX(r.OPERATION_END_DATE) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUIT_END_DATE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND s.CLASS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) AS UPCOMING_SCHEDULE_COUNT, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER), 0) FROM RESERVATION rv WHERE rv.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND rv.STATUS = '예약' ) AS APPLICANT_COUNT, c.STATUS AS CLASS_STATUS
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM CLASS c WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인'
AND c.STATUS = #{classStatus}
AND #{scheduleType} = '개별일정'
AND c.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY c.WRITE_DATE DESC, c.CLASS_CODE DESC
SELECT NVL(SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER), 0) FROM RESERVATION rv WHERE rv.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION rv JOIN SCHEDULE s ON rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = s.SCHEDULE_CODE WHERE rv.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND s.CLASS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND s.CLASS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
